ceo_directive: No invention gets to WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES or LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY if certificate says INCOMPLETE on load-bearing patent search

ci_rule.rule: If SEARCH_COMPLETENESS_CERTIFICATE.CERTIFICATION.status = INCOMPLETE AND CERTIFICATION.load_bearing = True, then final_status CANNOT be WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES or LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY
ci_rule.enforcement: Preflight checks for SEARCH_COMPLETENESS_CERTIFICATE.json in every invention folder. If status=INCOMPLETE and load_bearing=True, blocks advancement.
ci_rule.failure_action: CI_FAIL — invention cannot advance to WOULD_CONSIDER or BUYER_READY

fields_explained.DISCOVERY: Which databases were attempted, which queries ran, how many records returned, what failed
fields_explained.FAMILY: How many family roots found, members identified, members claim-audited
fields_explained.EVIDENCE: Candidates selected, claims retrieved, passages charted
fields_explained.102: References fully charted, references with all limitations, status
fields_explained.103: Analogous art searched, motivation evidence, expectation, teaching away, status
fields_explained.CERTIFICATION: COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE + blocking reasons + load_bearing flag

honest_distinction: 'We searched a lot' (narrative) != 'We searched enough' (certification). The certificate is mechanical, not narrative.
